name: The Christmas Story
source:
Why is there Christmas?
Is Christmas just a festive holiday with presents, food, songs and decorations?
Or is there a deeper meaning to Christmas?

'The Christmas Story' answers these questions.
It is adapted from the true story of Christmas that is sometimes forgotten behind the many Christmas activities. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=13099]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
圣诞节为何存在？
圣诞节难道只是一个有礼物、美食、歌曲和装饰的欢乐节日？
还是说，圣诞节背后另有更深的含义？

《圣诞故事》将回答这些问题。
它改编自圣诞节真实的由来——那段有时会被众多节庆活动掩盖、令人遗忘的故事。

[引自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=13099]官方网站[/url]]
